metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.5 · 2017 · Murder on the Orient Express
metas.description: When a murder occurs aboard the train on which he's travelling, celebrated Belgian detective Hercule Poirot is recruited to solve the case.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.3 · 2022 · Death on the Nile
metas.description: While on vacation on the Nile, Hercule Poirot must investigate the murder of a young heiress.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.5 · 2023 · A Haunting in Venice
metas.description: In post-World War II Venice, Poirot, now retired and living in his own exile, reluctantly attends a seance. But when one of the guests is murdered, it is up to the former detective to once again uncover the killer.
